coordinates.map_m: x = east, y = north, z = metres above grade (the lake surface is at -0.5); origin = Century Tower
coordinates.game: X = (x - cx) * 100, Y = z * 100, Z = -(y - cy) * 100 with (cx, cy) = center_m = (-1760, -660); Y is the ray-cast collision floor (Mario's feet), or the water surface (-50) for 'water_surface' points. Objects that hover (stars, coins) add their own offset.
coordinates.floor_m: collision floor measured by ray-casting the built level (STAND_FROM_M above the design height, straight down)
coordinates.depth_m: water depth at a water-surface point: surface -0.5 minus the floor under it. Mario wades below 1.0 m (his feet on the floor), swims deeper (pos.y < waterLevel - 100)

note: Anchor points for the Course 3 mission author (docs/game_design.md 7.4, Lake Alice, slot jrb / LEVEL_JRB, door 3 = Newell Hall, 8 stars). Re-generated on every `build_stage.py -- lake_alice` from the built collision; points with a 'check' key did not measure as designed. 'actN_' keys use the DESIGN act numbers (1 Boardwalk Welcome, 2 Gator Hop, 3 Shell Surf Regatta, 4 Bat Census at Dusk (2P+), 5 Lost Hatchling, 6 Lily Pad Red Coins); course.lua numbers the playable acts 1..n (solo acts first, docs/flow.md 5.1). The level script has NO level-script star (stars = []): every mission spawns its own (spawn_default_star from the controller loop, star id = course act - 1), or build_stage.py STAGE_STARS gets an entry. Alligators are mission objects (reskinned / original SM64 enemy stand-ins); this file only says where.

act1_boardwalk_welcome.note: Spawn -> lakeshore trail -> the north boardwalk (deck 0.5 m) -> wade onto the west bog -> walk it east -> the north_shallows lily pads (15, edge gaps 1.3 -> 2.4 m, a coin over each but the red-coin rest pad 5) -> the observation deck (octagon, top 0.2 m, pavilion roof apex 4.0 m). Skeeters / cheep-cheeps: skeeter_spots (water surface beside the pads), cheep_spots (1 m under the surface). A miss = swim to a pad and water-jump (A + stick forward at the surface) onto it.

act2_gator_hop.note: The island nest is on the small bog (lake_alice_water island 3, OSM w118249560), the bog uf_lake_missions.lua's gator line ends at: nest = the mound top, nest_island_top = the bog's middle (the module's island_3_top spot, kept clear for the star), mother_spot beside the mound. small_bog_landings: the bog's edge (0.25 m under water) at N / E / S / W, where a gator line can end. approach_south: the water depth every 5 m due south of the bog (the deep hole deep_1 lies there). big_gator_spots: deep water by the bog for the snapping big gators. The bog is also reachable by wading from the north bank (NEST_BANK): a big gator there guards it.

act3_shell_surf_regatta.note: Grab a Koopa shell at the start and surf the 8 buoys in order (closed loop). Buoys are >= 27 m from every shore and bog; every leg is open water >= 0.6 m deep with no wall 0.4 m above the surface (pads have no walls). Start candidates: the water off the Baughman lawn (regatta_dock_water), the north boardwalk's viewing bay, the Baughman footbridge.
act3_shell_surf_regatta.par_note: design par 75 s; a ridden shell tops out near 64 units/frame = 19 m/s, so the loop is ~40 s flat out

start.name: act3_start_water_baughman
start.note: a ridden shell floats on any water deeper than its floor

start.name: act3_shell_box_lawn
start.note: open lawn by the water for a shell box (a regatta start on land)

act4_bat_census.note: Three clipboard census stations (count only while staffed; 64-136 m apart, so one player cannot hold two). Swoopers stream out of the barns' open mesh bottoms (4.15 m) for 90 s at dusk. The 1991 Bat House was demolished in 2022 (its fenced plot is empty): a third stream can come from old_house_site at the same height. Dusk is a per-act Lua look (lighting / fog / skybox), the level's base is daytime.

dusk_look_hint.note: suggested values for the act 4 Lua. coopdx v1.5.1 has set_override_skybox(bg), set_lighting_color(ch, v), set_lighting_color_ambient(ch, v), set_lighting_dir(ch, v), set_fog_color(ch, v), set_fog_intensity(f), set_skybox_color(ch, v), set_vertex_color(ch, v) (ch = 0 red, 1 green, 2 blue; v = 0-255; tools/luatest/coopdx_api_v151.lua); apply them in act 4 only and restore the defaults when the act or level ends. The level's fog colour is baked into its display lists (gsDPSetFogColor 182, 206, 210).

act5_lost_hatchling.note: The baby gator waits on Museum Road (shore module spot) and must be carried to its mother at the nest on the small bog: carry_route = the shortest walk at grade on the built collision (A* on a 2 m grid, stage_points.ground_route) from the hatchling to the north bank above the bog (NEST_BANK), then a ~10 m wade (or throw it across to a friend on the bog). throw_spots: bank points by the bog.
